verdict.rationale: Gusto is a payroll and business-operations platform that offers automation-adjacent developer surfaces (CLI, MCP server, webhooks, API), so asking about versioning and rollback of automations is a fair question. However, no evidence shows any versioning, review, or rollback of automations. The CLI, MCP server, webhooks and OpenAPI items cover other stories and do not transfer here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
